rule: Books are independent resource reservoirs behind each Topic Arena. The student is never asked to read every book; the supervisor selects the smallest useful verified section for the current concept and mastery target. A catalog listing is not a full-text reading link.
source_handling: Only official publisher or openly accessible book URLs are published. The four user-supplied Google Drive PDFs are private review inputs, not public content or public links. No commercial book, paid solution, transcript, or copied problem set is hosted in this repository.

books.title: Chemistry 2e
books.authors: Paul Flowers, Klaus Theopold, Richard Langley, William R. Robinson
books.why: Free, section-addressable reference for short targeted reading with attribution; measure learning effectiveness with the pilot student.
books.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (current OpenStax web terms; uploaded historical PDF has different license text: verify intended version before reuse)
books.copyright_note: Use official section links with attribution. Do not bulk-ingest or republish book text into generative AI without permission; the online version's terms differ from this archived PDF's copyright page.
books.ai_note: Do not bulk-ingest the book into an LLM; use section links and human-curated mappings.

books.title: Chemistry: A Molecular Approach
books.author: Nivaldo J. Tro
books.why: Candidate visual bridge between macroscopic, molecular and symbolic chemistry, with a Sort → Strategize → Solve → Check problem-solving routine. Compare with other sources using actual student learning evidence.
books.copyright_note: Do not publish paid chapters or problem sets; link to publisher only.

books.title: Chemistry: The Central Science
books.authors: Theodore E. Brown, H. Eugene LeMay, Bruce E. Bursten, Catherine Murphy, Patrick Woodward, Matthew E. Stoltzfus
books.why: Candidate for independently created representative problem families and alternative strategies after an Arena concept has been understood; exam repetition has not been verified.
books.copyright_note: Do not publish copyrighted chapters, worked solutions, or original problem sets.

books.title: Chemistry: A Molecular Approach — AP Edition
books.author: Nivaldo J. Tro
books.publication_note: Pearson's AP correlation document states ©2023; the supplied PDF filename says 2022. Exact print publication date remains unverified.
books.why: Distinct AP edition. Exact CHEM 101 chapter and section coverage requires a readable table of contents; do not inherit the standard sixth edition's chapter mapping.
books.strengths: Potential alternative visual explanations and AP-aligned concept questions; not yet checked against this physical PDF.
books.limitations: The 282 MB supplied PDF returned no readable text through the current connector; no verified section or page-level mapping.
books.copyright_note: Restricted commercial text: do not publish the Drive link, PDF, copied questions, answers, or chapters.

books.title: Chemistry: The Central Science in SI Units — Global Edition
books.authors: Theodore L. Brown, H. Eugene LeMay Jr., Bruce E. Bursten, Catherine J. Murphy, Patrick M. Woodward, Matthew W. Stoltzfus
books.why: User-supplied SI-units edition; actual contents verify chapter-level support across all nine scope areas. Only a candidate until student trials identify efficient reading segments.
books.strengths: Direct chapter coverage of all nine arenas and SI-unit framing.
books.limitations: Chapter headings alone cannot confirm which examples are effective or relevant to instructor exams.
books.copyright_note: Never publish the full private PDF or its copied problem sets.

books.title: Introductory Chemistry in SI Units
books.author: Nivaldo J. Tro
books.why: Useful candidate for concise foundational explanations and problem-solving practice, with a verified gap in dedicated electrochemistry and only introductory treatment of heat/energy.
books.strengths: Numerical prerequisites, atomic structure, reactions, bonding, gas laws and solution concepts.
books.limitations: Ch. 3 energy is prerequisite support, not a replacement for a full thermochemistry chapter; Ch. 16 covers oxidation/reduction, not a standalone electrochemistry chapter.
books.copyright_note: Link to Pearson product; no publishing paid chapter text, worked examples or exercises.
